description: This is a JavaScript source file defining a UI component called 'Settings' for a smart TV weather display app. It uses LightningJS framework's Blits component to render a settings page with focus management.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A LightningJS Blits component representing the settings page, with state for focus index and items, and input handlers for navigation and back actions.

methods.name: state
methods.description: Returns the initial state object containing focus index and settings items.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Defines the UI layout of the settings page using LightningJS template syntax.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Handles 'up' input to move focus upward in the list.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Handles 'down' input to move focus downward in the list.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Handles 'back' input to navigate back to the previous route.
